title: iPhone Duo Launches With Carrier and Accessory Discounts Available
content:
Apple's new iPhone Duo is now available to purchase, and deals on cases, screen protectors, and the Duo itself are in abundance this week. Below, we're also tracking big discounts on Mac mini, Mac Studio, MacBook Pro, and more.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with Amazon. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

iPhone Duo Launch



  • What's the deal? Get big carrier discounts on iPhone Duo

  • Where can I get it? Cellular carriers

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

UP TO $1,200 OFF
iPhone Duo at AT&T

UP TO $1,000 OFF
iPhone Duo at T-Mobile


It's iPhone Duo launch day, and many cellular carriers are offering solid discounts on Apple's newest smartphone. At AT&T and T-Mobile, you can get up to $1,200 off the iPhone Duo with an eligible trade-in on one of their qualifying plans.

iPhone Duo Accessories



  • What's the deal? Get 20% off when you buy two or more accessories

  • Where can I get it? ZAGG

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

BUY 2 GET 20% OFF
iPhone Duo Accessories at ZAGG


If you got the iPhone Duo today, you'll probably be shopping for protection for your new device. With this in mind, we've gathered all of the best cases and screen protectors you can get for your new iPhone Duo, including accessories from popular brands like OtterBox, Speck, ZAGG/Mophie, and more.

Most of these retailers aren't offering discounts on iPhone Duo cases yet, but at ZAGG you can get 20 percent off your order when you purchase any two items, including iPhone Duo accessories. This is a perfect opportunity to get a case and screen protector for the smartphone at a discounted rate.

  • AT&T - Discounts on iPhone Duo cases and screen protectors from Speck, Spigen, and more

  • Best Buy - iPhone Duo cases from dbrand, OtterBox, Spigen, Kate Spade, and more

  • Target - iPhone Duo cases from ZAGG, Case-Mate, and Kate Spade

  • ZAGG - Save 20% when you buy 2 items from ZAGG, including iPhone Duo cases and screen protectors

Samsung recently kicked off a new discount event, which it's calling "Samsung Week," with big discounts across multiple product categories, including its most popular monitors and TVs. In regards to TVs, there are quite a few models of The Frame TV on sale, including low prices on the latest 2026 models.

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

M5 Max Mac Studio 36GB/512GB for $2,299.00

$119 OFF
M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB for $779.99

$149 OFF

Apple's M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB RAM and a 512GB SSD is still on sale for $2,299.00, down from $2,499.00. Regarding the Mac mini, you can get the 16GB RAM/256GB SSD Mac mini for $779.99, down from $899.00, and the 16GB RAM/512GB SSD model for $949.99, down from $1,099.00.

MacBook Pro



  • What's the deal? Get record low prices on 2026 MacBook Pro

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$900 OFF
16-inch MacBook Pro (M5 Max 36GB RAM/2TB) for $3,499.00


Amazon has introduced a giant $900 discount on the 36GB/2TB 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro, now priced at $3,499.00. This is the steepest discount on the 16-inch models right now, and one of the overall best deals we've seen on the 2026 MacBook Pro this year.
